name: NVDA/AMD Dollar-Neutral Pairs Strategy
description: Dollar-neutral pairs trading strategy on NVDA and AMD. Computes the NVDA/AMD price ratio, applies 20-day and 50-day SMAs to it, and trades crossover signals. Bull cross (fast SMA > slow SMA): long NVDA, short AMD. Bear cross (fast < slow): short NVDA, long AMD. Always in a position — flips on each crossover. Each leg sized at 50% of equity for approximate dollar neutrality.
source:
# NVDA/AMD Dollar-Neutral Pairs Trading Strategy
# Signal: NVDA/AMD price ratio with 20/50 SMA crossover
# Bull cross (fast > slow): long NVDA, short AMD
# Bear cross (fast < slow): short NVDA, long AMD
# Always in trade — flips on crossover, no flat periods
# Each leg: 50% of equity

# --- Data ---
# Primary asset data (runs per asset — NVDA or AMD)
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()

# Load both assets via reference for consistent ratio computation
nvda_ref = reference_stocks(ticker="NVDA")()
amd_ref = reference_stocks(ticker="AMD")()

# --- Ratio Signal (identical on both asset pages) ---
ratio = nvda_ref.c / amd_ref.c

# 20-day fast SMA and 50-day slow SMA on the ratio
fast_sma = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(ratio)
slow_sma = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(ratio)

# Crossover signals on the ratio SMAs
bull_cross = crossover(fast_sma, slow_sma)   # Ratio expanding — NVDA outperforming
bear_cross = crossunder(fast_sma, slow_sma)  # Ratio contracting — AMD outperforming

# Persistent state: bull until bear fires, and vice versa
bull_state = hold_until()(enter=bull_cross, exit=bear_cross)
bear_state = hold_until()(enter=bear_cross, exit=bull_cross)

# --- Per-Asset Signal Routing ---
# Identify which asset is currently running
is_nvda = is_asset_ref(ticker="NVDA")()
is_amd = is_asset_ref(ticker="AMD")()

# NVDA: long on bull, short on bear
# AMD: short on bull, long on bear (opposite side)
long_entry = (is_nvda and bull_state) or (is_amd and bear_state)
short_entry = (is_nvda and bear_state) or (is_amd and bull_state)

# --- Execution ---
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)

# 50% of equity per leg for dollar neutrality
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=50)
